result.rationale: The diff confirms TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` directly (in lib/topic_retriever.rb), invoking a scheduled job synchronously in-process rather than enqueueing it. This bypasses Sidekiq queueing semantics (PollFeed declares `sidekiq_options retry: false` and hourly recurrence, intended as a scheduled job) and couples the retriever to feed-poller internals. It is not a correctness defect verifiable from the diff, but it is a specific, substantive architecture/scope concern grounded in the new code.
